label: thm:su2-emergence
title: Emergence of the gauge group
html:
Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe, and let V denote the fundamental object of its fibre, of dimension N. Suppose

  1. (volume) the volume form is non-degenerate in the strong sense \Lambda^2 V \cong \mathbb{1}, equivalently \dim \Lambda^2 V = 1; and
  2. (realisation) the gauge group G = \mathrm{Aut}^{\otimes}(\tau) acts on \tau(V) \cong \mathbb{C}^N by matrices, each preserving the volume form (\det g = 1) and the Frobenius dagger (g\,g^{\dagger} = 1).

Then

  N = 2
  \qquad\text{and}\qquad
  G \subseteq \mathrm{SU}(N),

so G \subseteq \mathrm{SU}(2) — or its split real form \mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{R}), depending on the signature of the Frobenius pairing.

The two conclusions are independent, and only the first is about the rank. That g unitary with \det g = 1 lies in the special unitary group holds at every N; it carries no rank content whatever. What fixes N = 2 is hypothesis (1) alone, via \dim \Lambda^2 V = \binom{N}{2} = 1 \iff N = 2. Stating them as one conjunction is deliberate: an earlier formulation derived "which subgroup" and reported it as though it had also derived "which rank".

Non-vacuity. Hypothesis (1) is doing work rather than following from (2). At N = 3 it fails — \dim \Lambda^2 V = 3 — while the subgroup half applies at N = 3 unchanged. So the volume constraint is exactly what distinguishes rank two.

What is assumed and not proved. Hypothesis (2) is a realisation assumption: that \mathrm{Aut}^{\otimes}(\tau) is a set of matrices satisfying those two constraints. Nothing here derives that identification, and the statement is a theorem about such a set, not about the tensor-automorphism group as constructed. The weaker reading of the volume constraint, \Lambda^2 V \neq 0, gives only N \geq 2 and admits N = 3.

Lean structure

SU2EmergenceRankForced.lean carries the statement above as QOU.su2_emergence_rank_forced, sorry-free, together with the rank-free subgroup half QOU.mem_specialUnitary_of_unitary_of_det_one and the non-vacuity check QOU.su2_emergence_rank_hypothesis_is_load_bearing. The rank is sourced from QOU.BraidsAndKnots.exteriorSquareDim_eq_one_iff; the subgroup half composes the previously proved QOU.su2_emergence_combined.
